standard_prerequisites.name: The base change isomorphism for a single complex holds exactly when the canonical map from the derived pullback to the ordinary pullback satisfies the three equivalent conditions, and these conditions are inherited by suitable maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the tensor base change assertion to checking one condition for the map L(g')^*G to (g')^*G.

standard_prerequisites.name: For a complex of quasi-coherent modules flat over the base, the derived tensor with the base change ring computes as the ordinary tensor on stalks
standard_prerequisites.use: Verifies the stalk condition for the canonical map using flatness of G over S.

core_obligations: Formulate precisely: for g : S' to S with base change square X' = S' x_S X, the assertion is that Lg^*Rf_*(E tensor^L G^bullet) to Rf'_*(L(g')^*E tensor^L (g')^*G^bullet) is an isomorphism, with the ordinary pullback (not derived pullback) used on G^bullet (proof lines 6893-6908).

Reduce: applying Lemmas single-complex-base-change and single-complex-base-change-condition-inherited, it suffices to prove that the canonical map L(g')^*G^bullet to (g')^*G^bullet satisfies the equivalent conditions of Lemma single-complex-base-change-condition (proof lines 6909-6916).

Verify on stalks: at a pair of points x in X, s = f(x) in S, the stalk G^bullet_x tensor_{O_{S,s}} O_{S',s'} computes the derived tensor product because G^bullet is a bounded above complex of quasi-coherent modules flat over S, so the condition holds and the proof is complete (proof lines 6917-6925).
proof_roadmap: State the base change assertion with ordinary pullback on the flat complex (proof lines 6893-6908).
Reduce to the condition on the canonical map L(g')^*G to (g')^*G (proof lines 6909-6916).
Check the condition on stalks via flatness of G over S (proof lines 6917-6925).
